name: Attention Multiply (q/k/v/out weight scale)
plain: Scales the projection weights of attention layers instead of the attention values at runtime. It is a weight patch, like a LoRA with no delta, so it triggers a weight change on load.
math: For each state-dict key ending attn{1,2}.to_{q,k,v}.{weight,bias} or to_out.0.*: add_patches({key:(None,)}, strength_patch=0, strength_model=m), so W ← m·W.

props.architectures: UNet naming to_q/to_k/to_v (key suffix match; models without such keys are left unchanged silently). CLIP variant at line 69 acts on the text encoder.
